label: AWS Redshift
description: Long-format metric_daily table queried through psql. Use the Redshift endpoint and SSL settings in DATABASE_URL, or the PG* environment variables.

config.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_date, value, source, computed_at FROM analytics.metric_daily WHERE metric_date BETWEEN DATE '{{start}}' AND DATE '{{end}}' ORDER BY metric_key, metric_date
